# Matched Geometry

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

Move the same document symbol between two positions, linking its geometry through a shared identifier and namespace rather than replacing two unrelated views.

- Before: Positions change independently
- After: Shared geometry connects positions

APIs: `matchedGeometryEffect`, `@Namespace`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present GeometryDoExample() in your app.
struct GeometryDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            GeometryDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Run example") { phase += 1 }

            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct GeometryDoContent: View {
    var font: Font = .largeTitle
    let phase: Int
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Namespace private var space

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        HStack {
            if phase.isMultiple(of: 2) {
                Image(systemName: "doc.fill")
                        .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "document", in: space)
                Spacer()
            } else {
                Spacer()
                Image(systemName: "doc.fill")
                        .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "document", in: space)
            }
        }
        .font(font)
        .frame(width: 160)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth, value: phase)
        // The two branches share one namespace and never coexist as sources.
        // excerpt:end
    }

}
```
